2: A Song, a Psalm of David. Prepared is my heart, O God, I sing, yea, I sing praise, also my honour.
3: Awake, psaltery and harp, I awake the dawn.
4: I thank Thee among peoples, O Jehovah, And I praise Thee among the nations.
5: For great above the heavens is Thy kindness, And unto the clouds Thy truth.
6: Be Thou exalted above the heavens, O God, And above all the earth Thy honour.
7: That Thy beloved ones may be delivered, Save with Thy right hand, and answer us.
8: God hath spoken in His holiness: I exult, I apportion Shechem, And the valley of Succoth I measure,
9: Mine is Gilead, mine is Manasseh, And Ephraim is the strength of my head, Judah is my lawgiver,
10: Moab is a pot for my washing, Upon Edom I cast my shoe, Over Philistia I shout habitually.
11: Who doth bring me in to the fenced city? Who hath led me unto Edom?
12: Hast not Thou, O God, cast us off? And Thou goest not out, O God, with our hosts!
13: Give to us help from adversity, And vain is the salvation of man.
14: In God we do mightily, And He doth tread down our adversaries!
